question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: This question asks for AMD's Q3 2026 revenue, due to be reported on Nov 3, 2026. AMD guided to $13.0B ± $0.3B on its Q2 call. The analyst consensus is about $13.06-13.2B. The reference class is AMD's actual revenue against its guidance midpoint. AMD beat the midpoint by about $0.55B in Q3'25, $0.67B in Q4'25, $0.4B in Q1'26 and $0.34B in Q2'26, a beat of roughly 3-7%. That points to a median near $13.45B. Upside comes from EPYC/CPU strength (Stifel expects a beat) and early MI450 shipments in Q3. Downside comes from rumors that MI450 is behind schedule and from gaming weakness. No human market was found on Kalshi, Polymarket or Manifold. A result outside the range ($12B-$14.2B) would need a miss or beat of more than 7%, which I treat as very unlikely, so I declared no escape mass.
calls.dossier:
- AMD Q3 2026 outlook (Q2 press release, ~Aug 2026): revenue about $13.0B ± $0.3B (range $12.7-13.3B), about 41% YoY and 13% QoQ growth, non-GAAP GM about 56%.
- Q2 2026 actual: $11.536B against a guidance midpoint of $11.2B (+$0.34B, +3%). Data Center $6.72B (+107% YoY), Client $3.06B, Gaming $0.78B (-31% YoY), Embedded $0.98B (AMD IR).
- Q1 2026 actual: $10.25B against a consensus of $9.91B (+3.4%) (CNBC, May 5 2026).
- From memory, not re-verified: Q3 2025 actual $9.25B vs a $8.7B guide (+6%); Q4 2025 actual about $10.27B vs a $9.6B guide (+7%).
- Base rate over the last 4 quarters: actual revenue beat the guidance midpoint by 3-7% in every one (4 of 4). No miss of the midpoint was found in that window.
- Consensus for Q3 2026: about $13.06B from 38 analysts (TIKR/MarketBeat); another source shows $13.196B.
- Stifel (Oct 5 2026) raised its target to $700 and expects a Q3 revenue beat driven by EPYC. It says the first meaningful MI450 revenue falls in Q4, with an initial ramp in Q3.
- Downside items: rumors that MI450 is behind schedule (Yahoo); gaming segment shrinking.
- Report date: Nov 3, 2026, after market close (MarketBeat). That is after the question's scheduled resolution of Oct 29; the criteria text is blank, and the first revenue reported after September 2026 should be Q3 FY2026 total revenue.
- Resolves off total GAAP net revenue in AMD's Q3 FY2026 earnings release.
- Markets: searched Kalshi, Polymarket and Manifold; none found.
- Searched for but not found: Benzinga's full Stifel note (403 error), and any mid-quarter pre-announcement or guidance update.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: Q3 guide $13.0B±0.3B, Q2 actual $11.536B against an $11.2B guide, consensus $13.06-13.20B, report on Nov 3 resolving off total GAAP revenue for Q3 FY2026. Minor factual gaps: the Q1'26 guide midpoint (~$9.8B) and the Q3'25 guide ($8.7B) came from memory in the runs, are unverified, and don't change much. The question's scheduled resolution (Oct 29) falls before the Nov 3 report; this affects timing, not the value. The real disagreements are judgment calls: how much weight the shrinking beats get (I take ~3%, matching the latest quarter and Runs 2/3), the width (I keep Run 3's dispersion basis, about $0.75B), and escape mass (an upper escape needs a beat of more than 9%, which has no recent precedent but is possible with an early MI450 pull-in, so 2%; I omit a lower escape because a drop below $12B would need a miss of more than 7%, which I treat as negligible).
